items.q: Nexus is in my server but doesn't respond.
items.a: Check that Nexus can view and send messages in that channel, and that its role is high enough. The troubleshooting section covers the rest, and the status page shows whether Nexus is running.

items.q: I want a moderator to use a command without giving them a role.
items.a: Use -permission [command] [role, user or permission]. For example, -permission kick @Moderators lets anyone with that role kick, even if the command normally needs another permission. Run the same thing again to take it back off.

items.q: Where do I change the prefix?
items.a: Run -prefix set [prefix]. You need Manage Server to do it. Mentioning the bot always works too.

items.q: How do I undo a mute or a ban?
items.a: Use -unmute to remove a timeout or cancel a saved mute, and -unban to lift a ban. Each action creates a case, so you can see what happened in -cases.

items.q: A member says they didn't get a DM.
items.a: They may have server DMs turned off. The action still goes through and is still logged as a case.

items.q: Can I delete a case I made by mistake?
items.a: Yes, with -casedelete [case_number], which needs Ban Members. It voids the infraction and removes it from the record.

items.q: How long does Nexus keep my data?
items.a: Moderation cases and settings are kept until they're removed. Activity stats and join and leave records are removed after 30 days. The full breakdown is on the privacy page.

items.q: How do I ask for my data to be wiped?
items.a: Ask in the support server. Wipes are reviewed by hand, so they aren't guaranteed, but they are sometimes possible.

items.q: I found a bug or have an idea.
items.a: Post it in the support server. Include what you typed and what Nexus replied, if you can.
